from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAssetReport(BaseModel):
    """A single financial record extracted from one company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in the financial report")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the 'Total Non-current Assets' line item in the document")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of Total Non-current Assets")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency used in the report, e.g., CNY")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the report")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    reports: list[CompanyAssetReport]
